name: ALTESS
aliases: Alfuzosin Long-Term Efficacy and Safety Study
question: Does long-term alfuzosin prevent acute urinary retention or other progression events in men with LUTS/BPH?

design.population: 1,522 men with LUTS/BPH at risk of progression events and no previous acute urinary retention.
design.description: Multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized superiority trial
design.locator: Full text, Patients and Methods, pp 734-735

verdictNote: Primary urinary-retention endpoint missed; post hoc symptom-based progression favored alfuzosin.
takeaway: In 1,506 efficacy-evaluable men with LUTS/BPH, alfuzosin 10 mg once daily versus placebo did not reduce first acute urinary retention over two years (16/749 vs 14/757; P = 0.82); a post hoc composite of retention, BPH surgery or symptom worsening favored alfuzosin.

reports.label: Two-year primary report
reports.citation: Roehrborn CG; ALTESS Study Group. Alfuzosin 10 mg once daily prevents overall clinical progression of benign prostatic hyperplasia but not acute urinary retention: results of a 2-year placebo-controlled study. *BJU Int.* 2006;97(4):734-741. doi:10.1111/j.1464-410X.2006.06110.x
reports.followUpLocator: Full text, Patients and Methods, p 735

results.measure: First acute urinary retention through two years
results.note: Intent-to-treat efficacy population (at least one postbaseline efficacy criterion); no effect confidence interval reported.
results.locator: Full text, Patients and Methods and Results, p 735

results.note: Intent-to-treat; RR and CI converted from the reported relative risk reduction of 22% (95% CI -18% to 48%).
results.locator: Full text, Results and Fig. 1B, pp 735, 737

results.measure: Post hoc IPSS deterioration of at least 4 points through two years
results.note: Post hoc analysis in the intent-to-treat population; RR and CI converted from the reported relative risk reduction of 30% (95% CI 10% to 46%).
results.locator: Full text, Patients and Methods and Results, p 735; Fig. 1C, p 738

results.measure: Post hoc composite of acute urinary retention, BPH surgery or IPSS deterioration of at least 4 points through two years
results.note: Post hoc analysis in the intent-to-treat population; RR and CI converted from the reported relative risk reduction of 26% (95% CI 9% to 40%).
results.locator: Full text, Patients and Methods and Results, p 735; Fig. 1D, p 738

results.endpoint: IPSS, bother score and peak urinary flow
results.measure: Mean change in IPSS and bother score through two years; Qmax at 12 months
results.note: IPSS P = 0.0017 in the Results text (0.017 in the abstract); bother P < 0.001; Qmax P = 0.001. No confidence intervals reported.
results.locator: Full text, Patients and Methods and Results, p 735

harms.label: At least one treatment-emergent adverse event
harms.note: Exposed population; the Results prose reverses the arm assignment of these percentages.

harms.label: Serious treatment-emergent adverse events and discontinuation for adverse events
harms.note: Exposed population. Serious-event percentages recalculated from counts because printed percentages (11.7%, 11.4%) do not match denominators.

harms.label: Dizziness or postural dizziness and hypotension or postural hypotension

delivery.label: Study treatment

values.exp: alfuzosin 10 mg once daily after the same meal, without initial dose titration, for two years
values.ctl: matching placebo after the same meal for two years

delivery.locator: Full text, Patients and Methods, p 735

delivery.label: Completed two years of assigned study follow-up
delivery.note: Completion denominator is randomized patients; 1,009 completed the study across both arms.
